# VRFBuildWindow

**Class** · namespace `VRFramework.Core.Editors.Build` · assembly `VRFramework.Core.Editors` · [view source](https://git.cie-group.cz/vr-framework/vrf4/core/-/blob/interaction/physics-hold/Editor/Build/VRFBuildWindow.cs#L20)

One place to see what each build profile builds: the profiles in the project on the left,
the VRF settings of the selected one on the right, and the actions that apply them.

Unity's own Build Profiles window cannot host this. Its two extension points - the
`[BuildProfileSettingsProvider]`attribute and `IBuildProfileWindowAction`-
are both discovered through a filter that skips any type whose assembly is not a package
from the Unity registry, which no project or framework code can be. The settings still
live on the profile asset itself, so this window and that one are looking at the same
thing; only the drawing happens here.

```csharp
public class VRFBuildWindow : EditorWindow
```
